# **Gaps — no SOP yet**

- **Member onboarding flow**: No documented journey from sign-up → first class → retention checkpoint (weeks 1–4). Missing: goal-setting protocol, induction safety checks, buddy/coach assignment, comms cadence.
- **Churn & win-back mechanics**: No trigger-based pause/cancellation process or re-engagement playbook. No clear ownership of "at-risk" member identification.
- **Coaching standards & QA**: "Class Quality Audit Checklist" and "Coaching Development Roadmap" missing entirely—no documented baseline for class delivery, member experience, or coach progression.
- **Member outcomes & milestone tracking**: No SOP linking 30-day goals to actual results capture, celebrate, or upsell mechanism.
- **Referral programme ops**: Who tracks referrals? How is incentive triggered? No process for attribution or fulfilment.
- **Health & safety incidents**: No documented complaint-handling, injury reporting, or safeguarding escalation SOP (critical for women's gym).
- **Member data & GDPR**: Data retention, consent audit, subject access request handling—non-negotiable for compliance.
- **Troubleshooting guide**: Member issues (billing, access, class issues, complaints) routed ad-hoc; no escalation or resolution SOP.

---

# **Needs updating**

- **Coaches SOPs (21/24)**: Likely missing real-time feedback loops, observation/shadowing protocol, and how coaching competency is actually assessed beyond title.
- **Facilities (8/8)**: Probably don't cover member-facing incident response (e.g., injury, equipment failure, facility closure).
- **Marketing (6/6)**: No clear handoff between acquisition campaigns and member onboarding success metrics; no retention/referral feedback loop.

# Service Menu Build — Concrete Execution for Grace

• **Start with your *existing* revenue conversations** — Pull your last 20 member sign-ups and 10 coach inquiries. What questions did they ask repeatedly? What did you *actually* end up selling vs. what you thought you'd sell? Build the menu around real demand, not theoretical offerings. This takes 90 mins, not days.

• **Create TWO separate one-pagers** (not a novel):
  - **Coach version**: What can they sell/recommend? Pricing tiers they can quote. Commission structure if applicable. Keep it sales-focused so they're confident upselling.
  - **Member version**: Simple visual (even just a clean table). Price | Duration | What's Included | How to Buy. Test it with 3 members first — does it confuse anyone?

• **Anchor pricing to your *actual* cost per hour** — Don't copy competitors. How much does a coach cost you per session? What's your studio overhead per hour? Mark up 3x minimum. If you can't do that math in 10 minutes, your pricing will sabotage growth.

• **Lock in a "no changes" window** — Commit to this menu for 90 days minimum. Grace, you'll want to tweak it constantly. Don't. Use those 90 days to see what actually *sells*, then iterate once with data.

• **Post it where it drives action** — Not just on your website. Printed in the gym. In WhatsApp. Sent to every inquiry within 2 hours. The menu only works if people actually *see* it when they're deciding.
